Residue: Residues with a heavy atom within 4 A of the ligand in the structure of the human VDR ligand-binding domain with 1alpha,25-dihydroxyvitamin D3 (PDB 1DB1), numbered as in the PDB entry. Hydrogen bond: a protein N or O atom within 3.5 A of a ligand O atom. Residues of the other proteins are taken from the alignments of the phylogenetic analysis.
